In detail

Residential Utrecht. Utrecht publishes police registrations and survey results by wijk through its own research office. Registered crime across the city rose 10% in 2025, driven by home burglary, thefts from cars, bicycle theft and violence, and 59% of residents reported seeing at least one suspicious situation in their neighbourhood that year. This wijk is inside that citywide picture but is not among the three the city's 2025 figures single out for youth nuisance, and no separate per-wijk finding for it turned up. The dashed outline records that as an absence rather than an all-clear.

Frequently asked questions

Is Noordoost safe?

Wandroz rates Noordoost in Utrecht as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Utrecht. That rating rests on an area-level review that reached no traveller-relevant reporting specific to Noordoost — no incidents, no recurring problems, nothing documented either way — read together with the character of the area. It is not a positive finding of safety: an absence of reporting is weaker evidence than the sourced ratings elsewhere on this map, and it is marked as such wherever it appears.

What was checked for Noordoost?

The same area-level review every other neighbourhood on the Utrecht map gets: local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist, searched for this specific area. Noordoost returned nothing traveller-relevant, which is common for smaller administrative areas without a press profile of their own. Where a review does return something, the sources are named on the area's page.

Is Noordoost a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Nothing documented argues against it. For a stay, weigh that against the areas on the Utrecht map whose ratings are backed by named sources, and check recent reviews for the specific street. You can search accommodation already scoped to this area using the Booking.com link on this page.
